==Overview==
The '''ASL Season 19'''<ref>[https://ch.sooplive.co.kr/afstar1/post/153414807]</ref> ('''ASL 시즌 19''') (Formerly '''2025 SSL SPRING'''), is an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[SOOP]].<br>
On March 7, 2025, the name of the tournament was changed from "SOOP StarCraft League" ("SSL") to "ASL".

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p_mgWKuYp2g</embedvideo>

==Tournament Information==
===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: {{abbr/Bo1}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[SOOP/StarCraft League/2024/AUTUMN|2024 SSL AUTUMN]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: First two matches: {{abbr/Bo1}} - Final three matches: {{abbr/Bo3}}
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** All matches: {{abbr/Bo7}}
